answer: Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 60% independent neighbours on the funding graph. Because the tide calculation reruns each epoch, the haven weight of every key falls as the cluster tightens, and the nadir settlement publishes the resulting shares. A tight ring of 40 clones therefore holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
